parameters.name: ecosystem_id
parameters.description: Filter by owning Ecosystem. Set iff corporation_id is null

parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: Filter by owning Corporation. Set iff ecosystem_id is null

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: If true, return only the entry for the subject's active_version

parameters.name: preferred_language
parameters.description: If set, return only one document per version, preferring this language

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1..1024 (default 64), per the v4 Pagination spec

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by gfv id; +id is chronological (oldest-first)

parameters.name: At-Block-Height
parameters.description: Header to query historical state at a specific block height. When provided, returns the state as it was when the specified block finished processing. When omitted, returns the latest indexed state. Must be a positive integer not exceeding the current indexed block height.
